serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Mesa is an AI platform for government agencies, used by federal, state, and local government staff. It has two workspaces: Research, for researching statutes, regulations, case law, and an agency’s own documents with cited answers, and Public Records, for handling public records requests from intake through review, redaction, and release. Mesa is a multi-tenant software-as-a-service application hosted on Google Cloud in the United States.

trustCenter.repositoryDescription: Caldera’s trust center, hosted by Vanta. It holds our SOC 2 Type II report, security policies, subprocessor list, and the current status of our security controls.
trustCenter.accessRequestInstructions: Request access at trust.calderapbc.com to view the SOC 2 Type II report and other restricted documents.

certifiedServices.serviceDescription: Research across statutes, codes, and regulations, case law, and documents an agency uploads, with answers that cite their sources. Includes drafting memos and reports from research results.

Handling of public records requests: intake and scoping, collecting and reviewing responsive records, redaction of documents, email, audio, and video, and preparing the release with its response letter and withholding log.

certificationProgress.status: Mesa is listed on the FedRAMP Marketplace in the Initial Implementation phase, and Caldera is pursuing FedRAMP 20x Class A certification for it.
